svg.title: A year in characters
svg.desc: Every day of the last year written as one character on a practice sheet, each season in its own ink; the more I committed, the more ink the character takes, and the best day of each month is circled. 3,260 contributions in the last year · longest run 60 days · current run 60 days · busiest nov 17 (158), in vermilion.
svg.text: 一年 · A year in characters
Every day is one character; the more I committed, the more ink it takes.
3,260 CONTRIBUTIONS IN THE LAST YEAR · LONGEST RUN 60 DAYS · CURRENT RUN 60 DAYS · BUSIEST NOV 17 (158), IN VERMILION
